newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Higher rates for panamxaes in Eas.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Higher rates for panamxaes in Eas.

text.p: Significantly higher rates were seen for panamaxes in the East, although brokers reported caper and handy-size rates at no more than stable in that area.
Grain chartering activity continued to increase from the Plate and Brazil for panamaxes and handies and a number of fresh orders have appeared.
However, early capers, especially over-age units, are struggling to repeat last done rates in the Atlantic.
The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up three points to 1,493.
GRAIN - Fixing from the U.S. Gulf was slow compared to south America.

Halla booked M.N. Cerrahoglu for 54,000 tonnes heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Taiwan for end April at $24.50, but the vessel's overall length is 248 metres, which makes her ineligible for many discharge ports.
The same applies to Bobilna (253 metres) reported fixed Brazil/Indonesia for end April at $25.00.

Cho Yang was linked to the Rondeau-relet Full Sources 69,400 dwt delivery U.S. Gulf early April trip Japan at $15,300 daily plus $315,000 ballast bonus, and Pan Ocean was said to have fixed Sumava 70,456 dwt for similar business at between $15,300/$15,650 daily and $300,000/$325,000 ballast bonus.
March positions in the U.S. Gulf continued soft.
The Auk 65,000 dwt was believed to have ballasted from Key West to the Plate to fix Continental with grain to Israel.

Safmarine was thought to have agreed $15,500 daily for the Navios-relet Oceanic Explorer 68,849 dwt delivery Cape Passero March 21 trip via the Plate to the Far East on subjects, but reports that Dreyfus fixed 45,000 tonnes soybeans Brazil/New Orleans for end March loading at $12.00 could not be confirmed.
In the handies brokers suggested that Cargill had fixed 20,000 tonnes wheat St. Lawrence/Buenaventura on private terms and 22,500/25,000 wheat U.S. Gulf/Algeria for March at $24.00.
But the focus of handy grain fixing was east coast south America.
Agro-Grain took Treasure Island for 20,000 Sao Francisco do Sul/Adriatic at $27.50, and Continental booked Alycia 21,500 dwt prompt Plate for grain to Egypt on private terms.
Brokers report a high volume of new and outstanding orders from the Plate.
From Gibraltar Copenship fixed the 1973-built Arcadia 22,312 dwt for a trip via the Continent to Bangladesh at $7,950 daily.
Among new orders quoted today was Toepfer with 50,000 tonnes wheat Plate/Aqaba April 15/22.

Others were, Tradigrain 50,000 tones wheat Plate/Trincomalee April 15/21 and 25,000 tonnes corn Plate/Tunisia April 14/18, Dreyfus 20/35,000 products Plate/Turkey March 24/April 5, and Continental 1.4/2.4 miliion cubic feet Plate/Saudi Arabia prompt/onwards.

Transcatalana (having failed on subjects at about $17.25) were again in the market for an April panamax for 50/52,000 sbm Paranagua/Spanish Med, and Safmarine quoted a timecharter order for a panamax delivery Recalada mid-April trip Far East.
MINERALS - Rates for capers in the Atlantic appeared to be slipping.
A number of older types were available in prompt positions without suitable business to negotiate.
Little was heard of panamaxes in the Atlantic mineral trades. ICL Parthiban 55,822 dwt was reported fixed delivery Black Sea trip Far East by Linkvest at $13,250 daily.

Caper rates were said to be steady in the East, but panamax levels continued to appreciate. The 1977-built Heliopolis 64,464 dwt was taken by Transfield delivery Philiipines end March for a trip via W.Australia to China at a firmer $13,250 daily and MOSK booked Maritime Mosaic 73,657 dwt delivery Muscat early April trip via Goa to Japan at close to $14,500 daily.

The 1983-built Samsun Spirit 67,368 dwt was thought booked from the Far East for an Australian round trip at $12,000 daily, but the 1976-built Menalon 66,464 dwt obtained only about $9,750/$10,000 daily retro sailing N.China March 16 for a Nopac round from Chinese charterers.
Panamaxes continued to be popular with charterers for period business.
BIFFEX futures at 1600 GMT were 10 to 22 points easier, after trading 71 lots. Most active October sold 23 lots and traded last at 1,430, down 10 points.
